name: How much does it typically cost to design and build an ADU in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it typically cost to design and build an ADU in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of designing and building an ADU in Orange County varies significantly based on size, type, finishes, and site conditions. A basic garage conversion might start from $80,000 to $150,000, while a new detached ADU can range from $150,000 to over $300,000. These figures include design, permits, materials, and construction. A detailed estimate requires an on-site evaluation of your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for an ADU in Orange County range from $80,000 for a basic garage conversion to over $300,000 for a new detached unit, depending on size, type, and finishes.
